name: sniper_receiver
brief: The precision rifle's body, which its parts mount on: long and slim, a round action in a chassis with a bolt handle on the right, a high rail on risers for big scopes, a long free-float handguard with a short braced foregrip under it (the off hand's place), a magwell. Sand body, graphite chassis, ice lights. Barrel, magazine, stock, sight and muzzle device are separate part models (assets/weapons/parts).
